description: A false-colour satellite image depicts a wide, braided river system, showcasing multiple water channels, extensive sand and gravel bars, and surrounding riparian and floodplain areas. The water channels appear in dark blue. Large, elongated areas within the riverbed, displaying orange and light brown tones, represent accumulations of sand and gravel, consistent with the definition of river banks and bars having little or no vegetation (less than 10%). The vegetated areas adjacent to the river, possibly agricultural fields or natural floodplain vegetation, are rendered in shades of light green and yellow. This image serves as an example illustrating the appearance of river banks, such as those found in the Tor region, with active sediment deposition and complex channel morphology.
